title: FDA approves Cogent's drug for rare stomach cancer
html:

Good morning. Hope you all have a great Thanksgiving tomorrow! I will probably be watching 10 hours straight of football.

FDA approves Cogent’s drug for rare stomach cancer

Cogent Biosciences yesterday won FDA clearance for its stomach cancer treatment, which will be marketed as Ekitna, in combination with a much older drug from Pfizer called Sutent.
